f.title: Follow authority-set matters during a designated safety surveillance period
f.statement: For a drug approved for manufacture or import, the central competent health authority may designate a period during which its safety is monitored. Pharmaceutical firms shall follow the matters set by the central competent health authority for that safety surveillance period.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 4 March 2026). Only pharmacovigilance, safety, recall and safety-labelling provisions captured. Drugs approved for manufacture or import for which a surveillance period is designated. Implemented by the Regulations for Drug Safety Surveillance Management (藥品安全監視管理辦法).

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical firm (藥商) holding a manufacture or import approval
rows.quote:
經核准製造或輸入之藥物，中央衛生主管機關得指定期間，監視其安全性。
 藥商於前項安全監視期間應遵行事項，由中央衛生主管機關定之。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. The authority sets the period (得); the firm's duty to follow the matters set (應遵行事項) is Mandatory. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. Accountable changed from governance-1 (QPPV, not a Taiwan statutory role) to governance-3 for consistency. Below 90: 得指定期間 is the authority's power and the firm's duty (應遵行事項) is to follow matters the authority sets in subsidiary regulations; the content of the duty is not in the quote.
rows.quote_en:
For drugs approved for manufacture or import, the central competent health authority may designate a period to monitor their safety.
The matters that pharmaceutical firms shall follow during the safety surveillance period in the preceding paragraph shall be prescribed by the central competent health authority.

f.title: Report serious adverse reactions caused by drugs
f.statement: Medical institutions, pharmacies and pharmaceutical firms shall report serious adverse reactions caused by drugs. The reporting method, content and other matters to be followed are set by regulations of the central competent health authority.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 4 March 2026). Only pharmacovigilance, safety, recall and safety-labelling provisions captured. Implemented by the Regulations for Reporting Serious Adverse Reactions of Medicaments (嚴重藥物不良反應通報辦法).

rows.actor: Medical institutions, pharmacies and pharmaceutical firms (藥商)
rows.quote: 醫療機構、藥局及藥商對於因藥物所引起之嚴重不良反應，應行通報；其方式、內容及其他應遵行事項之辦法，由中央衛生主管機關定之。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. 應行通報 = Mandatory; actors explicit; no deadline in the Act (method and content left to subsidiary regulations, as stated).
rows.quote_en: Medical institutions, pharmacies and pharmaceutical firms shall report serious adverse reactions caused by drugs; the regulations on the method, content and other matters to be followed shall be prescribed by the central competent health authority.

f.title: Obtain approval before changing registered particulars of an approved drug
f.statement: The originally registered particulars of a drug approved for manufacture or import shall not be changed without the approval of the central competent health authority.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 4 March 2026). Only pharmacovigilance, safety, recall and safety-labelling provisions captured.

rows.quote: 經核准製造、輸入之藥物，非經中央衛生主管機關之核准，不得變更原登記事項。
rows.review_note: Review: no change; kept for consistency with the English curation (safety label changes to registered particulars need prior approval). Article 46(2) transfer registration not captured (not PV). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. Below 90: quote is passive (不得變更原登記事項) and does not name the actor; permit holder inferred; PV relevance is indirect (safety label changes).
rows.quote_en: For drugs approved for manufacture or import, the originally registered particulars shall not be changed without the approval of the central competent health authority.

f.title: Make improvements within the time limit ordered after a safety re-evaluation
f.statement: Where, during the validity period of a drug's manufacture or import permit, the central competent health authority re-evaluates the drug and confirms a concern about its safety or medical efficacy, it may (得) order the pharmaceutical firm to make improvements within a time limit. The firm's duty arises only when the authority so orders; once ordered, the firm must make the improvements within the time limit, failing which the permit is revoked. Where the safety concern is serious, the authority may revoke the permit directly.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 4 March 2026). Only pharmacovigilance, safety, recall and safety-labelling provisions captured.
f.exceptions: Applies only when the authority orders improvement (authority discretion: 得); for a serious safety concern the authority may revoke the permit directly.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical firm (permit holder), when ordered by the central competent health authority
rows.deadline: Within the time limit set in the authority's order
rows.quote: 藥物於其製造、輸入許可證有效期間內，經中央衛生主管機關重新評估確定有安全或醫療效能疑慮者，得限期令藥商改善，屆期未改善者，廢止其許可證。但安全疑慮重大者，得逕予廢止之。
rows.review_note: Review: statement restated so the firm's duty arises only on the authority's order (得 = authority power; compliance Mandatory, backed by revocation). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. Below 90: 得限期令藥商改善 is the authority's power; the firm's duty arises only on the authority's order, with a time limit set in the order.
rows.quote_en: Where, during the validity period of its manufacture or import permit, a drug is re-evaluated by the central competent health authority and confirmed to raise concerns about safety or medical efficacy, the authority may order the pharmaceutical firm to make improvements within a time limit; if no improvement is made by the deadline, its permit shall be revoked. However, where the safety concern is serious, the permit may be revoked directly.

f.title: Handle or recall unused specially approved drugs within the time limit when ordered
f.statement: The central competent health authority may (得) revoke a special approval granted under Article 48-2(1) where: (1) a drug that has obtained a permit, or a suitable alternative therapy, can meet the need in item 1 of that paragraph; (2) the emergency or event with major public health impact has ended; or (3) the authority has evaluated the drug and found that it does raise concerns affecting medication safety or medical efficacy. Where necessary, the authority may order the applicant to handle or recall the unused drugs within a time limit. The applicant's duty arises only when the authority so orders; once ordered, the applicant must handle or recall the unused drugs within that time limit.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 4 March 2026). Only pharmacovigilance, safety, recall and safety-labelling provisions captured. Drugs specially approved under Article 48-2(1) (prevention or treatment of life-threatening or severely disabling diseases without a suitable drug or alternative therapy, or the needs of an emergency or event with major public health impact).
f.exceptions: Applies only if the authority revokes the special approval and, where necessary, orders handling or recall (authority discretion: 得).

rows.actor: Applicant for a special approval under Article 48-2(1), when ordered by the central competent health authority
rows.deadline: Within the time limit set by the authority
rows.quote:
有下列情形之一者，中央衛生主管機關得廢止前項核准；必要時，得令申請者就未使用之藥品限期處理或回收：
 一、已有取得許可證之藥品或有合適替代療法可提供前項第一款情事之需要。
 二、緊急或重大影響公共衛生情事已終結。
 三、藥品經中央衛生主管機關評估確有影響用藥安全或醫療效能疑慮。
rows.review_note: Review: statement restated so the applicant's duty arises only on the authority's order; applicability no longer says 'domestically' (the row's quote does not). Chinese differs from the MOJ English: (a) Chinese 令申請者...限期處理或回收 orders the applicant to handle OR RECALL unused drugs within a time limit, whereas the English has the applicant only 'handle' them and the authority 'publicly announce the recall'; (b) item 1 is 已有取得許可證之藥品 (a permitted drug already exists), English 'a drug obtains market approval'; (c) item 3 is 評估確有...疑慮 (evaluated and found to indeed raise concerns about medication safety or efficacy), English 'reviewed and considered with concerns'. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. Below 90: both 得廢止 and 得令申請者...限期處理或回收 are authority powers; the applicant's duty to handle or recall arises only on an order made "where necessary" and the time limit is set in the order. Applicability describes Article 48-2(1), which is outside the quote.
rows.quote_en:
Under any of the following circumstances, the central competent health authority may revoke the approval in the preceding paragraph; where necessary, it may order the applicant to handle or recall the unused drugs within a time limit:
1. A drug that has obtained a permit, or a suitable alternative therapy, is available to meet the need in item 1 of the preceding paragraph.
2. The emergency or event with major impact on public health has ended.
3. The drug has been evaluated by the central competent health authority and found to indeed raise concerns affecting medication safety or medical efficacy.

f.title: Show warnings and cautionary symbols or colours on labels of controlled and poisonous drugs
f.statement: The labels of controlled drugs and poisonous or potent drugs shall carry warning statements and pictograms or colours sufficient to alert users.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 4 March 2026). Only pharmacovigilance, safety, recall and safety-labelling provisions captured. Controlled drugs and poisonous or potent drugs (毒劇藥品). No row for this Article in the English-version curation.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical firm (藥商) responsible for the drug label
rows.quote: 管制藥品及毒劇藥品之標籤，應載明警語及足以警惕之圖案或顏色。
rows.review_note: Review: no change; kept in scope as a safety-labelling duty (warnings and cautionary pictograms or colours on controlled and poisonous or potent drugs). Not in the English curation. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. Below 90: quote is passive (標籤，應載明) and does not name the actor (label holder inferred); scope judgement (Article 59 is controlled-drug management, kept as safety labelling); no counterpart row in the English curation.
rows.quote_en: The labels of controlled drugs and poisonous and potent drugs shall state warnings and bear pictograms or colours sufficient to serve as a warning.

f.title: Show side effects, contraindications and other precautions on labels and inserts as approved
f.statement: The labels, package inserts or packaging of drugs shall carry, as approved: (1) the manufacturer name and address; (2) the product name and permit number; (3) the batch number; (4) the manufacturing date and the validity period or shelf life; (5) the content of main ingredients, dosage and administration; (6) the main efficacy, performance or indications; (7) side effects, contraindications and other precautions; and (8) other particulars required by regulations. Item (4) need not be shown where the central competent health authority has expressly announced an exemption.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 4 March 2026). Only pharmacovigilance, safety, recall and safety-labelling provisions captured.
f.exceptions: Item 4 (manufacturing date and validity period or shelf life) may be omitted where the authority has expressly announced the exemption.

rows.quote:
藥物之標籤、仿單或包裝，應依核准刊載左列事項：
 一、廠商名稱及地址。
 二、品名及許可證字號。
 三、批號。
 四、製造日期及有效期間或保存期限。
 五、主要成分含量、用量及用法。
 六、主治效能、性能或適應症。
 七、副作用、禁忌及其他注意事項。
 八、其他依規定應刊載事項。
 前項第四款經中央衛生主管機關明令公告免予刊載者，不在此限。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Chinese item 7 is 副作用、禁忌及其他注意事項 (side effects, contraindications and other precautions); the MOJ English renders it 'adverse reactions, contraindications, and other warnings and precautions', adding 'warnings' and using 'adverse reactions' for 副作用. The Chinese quote also includes item 8 and the item 4 exemption (75(2)), which the English row omits. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. Below 90: quote is passive (標籤、仿單或包裝，應依核准刊載) and does not name the actor; permit holder inferred.
rows.quote_en:
The labels, package inserts or packaging of drugs shall carry the following particulars as approved:
1. Name and address of the manufacturer.
2. Product name and permit number.
3. Batch number.
4. Date of manufacture and validity period or shelf life.
5. Content of the main ingredients, dosage and administration.
6. Main efficacy, performance or indications.
7. Side effects, contraindications and other precautions.
8. Other particulars required to be carried under regulations.
This does not apply to item 4 of the preceding paragraph where the central competent health authority has expressly announced that it may be omitted.

f.title: Stop distribution of drugs prohibited for serious hazards within the time limit
f.statement: Where a drug approved for manufacture or import is found to cause a serious hazard, the central competent health authority shall at any time announce a prohibition of its manufacture and import and revoke its drug permit. For drugs already manufactured or imported, the authority shall prohibit, within a time limit, their export, dispensing, sale, supply, transport, storage, brokering, transfer or display with intent to sell, and may confiscate and destroy them where necessary. Holders of drugs already manufactured or imported must stop these activities by the time limit set in the authority's prohibition; this duty arises only when the authority issues the prohibition.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 4 March 2026). Only pharmacovigilance, safety, recall and safety-labelling provisions captured.

rows.actor: Central competent health authority; holders of the affected drugs subject to the prohibition
rows.deadline: Within the time limit set in the prohibition
rows.quote: 經許可製造、輸入之藥物，經發現有重大危害時，中央衛生主管機關除應隨時公告禁止其製造、輸入外，並廢止其藥物許可證；其已製造或輸入者，應限期禁止其輸出、調劑、販賣、供應、運送、寄藏、牙保、轉讓或意圖販賣而陳列，必要時並得沒入銷燬之。
rows.review_note: Review: statement restated: in the Chinese the authority is the subject of 應限期禁止 (it shall prohibit within a time limit), so the holders' duty is to comply once the prohibition is issued. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. Statement last sentence reworded (holders must stop by the time limit set in the prohibition). Below 90: every modal in the quote (應隨時公告禁止, 應限期禁止, 得沒入銷燬) binds the authority; the holders' duty to comply is inferred, not stated, and the actor is mixed.
rows.quote_en: Where a drug approved for manufacture or import is found to pose a serious hazard, the central competent health authority shall, in addition to announcing at any time a prohibition of its manufacture and import, revoke its drug permit; for those already manufactured or imported, it shall, within a time limit, prohibit their export, dispensing, sale, supply, transport, storage, brokering, transfer or display with intent to sell, and where necessary may confiscate and destroy them.

f.title: Notify healthcare providers immediately and recall drugs within the prescribed period
f.statement: Where a drug falls under any of the following, its manufacturer or importer shall immediately notify medical institutions, pharmacies and pharmaceutical firms, recall the marketed products within the prescribed period, and handle them together with inventory in accordance with the Act: (1) its permit was held but its manufacture or import has been prohibited by announcement; (2) it is legally determined to be a counterfeit, substandard or prohibited drug; (3) it is legally determined to be a defective medical device or a medical device manufactured or imported without approval; (4) inspection of the drug manufacturing plant finds that the drug in fact damages, or may damage, the life, body or health of users; (5) the manufacture or import permit was not renewed or renewal was refused; (6) other recalls announced by the central competent health authority.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 4 March 2026). Only pharmacovigilance, safety, recall and safety-labelling provisions captured. Recall classification, handling methods and implementation are set by separate regulations of the central competent health authority (Article 80(3)).

rows.actor: Manufacturer or importer of the drug
rows.deadline: Notify immediately (應即); recall marketed products within the prescribed period (依規定期限)
rows.quote:
藥物有下列情形之一，其製造或輸入之業者，應即通知醫療機構、藥局及藥商，並依規定期限收回市售品，連同庫存品一併依本法有關規定處理：
 一、原領有許可證，經公告禁止製造或輸入。
 二、經依法認定為偽藥、劣藥或禁藥。
 三、經依法認定為不良醫療器材或未經核准而製造、輸入之醫療器材。
 四、藥物製造工廠，經檢查發現其藥物確有損害使用者生命、身體或健康之事實，或有損害之虞。
 五、製造、輸入藥物許可證未申請展延或不准展延。
 六、其他經中央衛生主管機關公告應回收。
rows.review_note: Review: removed the sentence on recall classification regulations from the statement (Article 80(3), not in the quote; kept in applicability). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. 應即 = Mandatory; actor (製造或輸入之業者) explicit; deadlines "immediately" for notification and "within the prescribed period" for recall are as stated in the quote; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en:
Where a drug falls under any of the following circumstances, its manufacturer or importer shall immediately notify medical institutions, pharmacies and pharmaceutical firms, recall the products on the market within the prescribed period, and handle them together with the products in inventory in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Act:
1. A permit was originally held, but manufacture or import has been prohibited by announcement.
2. It has been legally determined to be a counterfeit, substandard or prohibited drug.
3. It has been legally determined to be a defective medical device, or a medical device manufactured or imported without approval.
4. Inspection of the drug manufacturing plant finds that its drugs in fact damage the life, body or health of users, or are likely to cause such damage.
5. No renewal of the drug manufacture or import permit was applied for, or renewal was refused.
6. Others that the central competent health authority has announced shall be recalled.

f.title: Cooperate with manufacturers and importers in drug recalls
f.statement: When a manufacturer or importer recalls drugs falling under any item of Article 80(1), medical institutions, pharmacies and pharmaceutical firms shall cooperate.
f.applicability: Taiwan; Traditional Chinese original text from the Laws & Regulations Database (as amended 4 March 2026). Only pharmacovigilance, safety, recall and safety-labelling provisions captured. Recalls under Article 80(1).
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.actor: Medical institutions, pharmacies and pharmaceutical firms (藥商)
rows.quote: 製造、輸入業者回收前項各款藥物時，醫療機構、藥局及藥商應予配合。
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, actor and numbers. 應予配合 = Mandatory; actors explicit; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: When manufacturers or importers recall drugs under the items of the preceding paragraph, medical institutions, pharmacies and pharmaceutical firms shall cooperate.
